mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_sms_delivery_record ( request_id, challenge_id, provider_code, purpose, masked_mobile, mobile_hash, template_code, content_snapshot, sensitive_content_retained, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{challengeId}, #{providerCode}, #{purpose}, #{maskedMobile}, #{mobileHash}, #{templateCode}, #{contentSnapshot}, #{sensitiveContentRetained}, 'PROCESSING', 0, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_sms_delivery_record SET status = 'ACCEPTED', provider_message_id = #{providerMessageId}, accepted_time = #{acceptedTime}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_sms_delivery_record SET status = 'FAILED', provider_message_id = NULL, accepted_time = NULL, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND is_deleted = false
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, challenge_id, provider_code, purpose, masked_mobile, template_code, content_snapshot, sensitive_content_retained, status, provider_message_id, failure_code, failure_message, accepted_time, created_time FROM public.auth_sms_delivery_record WHERE ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
